entities.name: Doctor Zlovol
entities.description: Simic viromancer from Ravnica who performed unethical experiments on dangerous diseases.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov figure who served the prosecutor against Zlovol.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild whose contractors were to receive victims' remains.

events.summary: Zlovol failed to hand over remains of the guildless deceased and was sued by the Orzhov; with Teysa Karlov serving the prosecutor, he was found guilty.
events.quote: he was found guilty of violating the contract

relations.quote: Doctor Zlovol was a Simic viromancer from Ravnica
